QuestInfo.name: The Queen's Accessories
QuestInfo.0: Areda, the queen of Ariant, known for her extravagant tastes says that regular jewels don't draw her interest at all. Ask her what she is looking for.
QuestInfo.1: Areda tells you that the jewel must be at least like the #r#t4000946##k and #r#t4000948##k, buried at #b#MDmirrorD_322_3_##k to even remotely be good enough for her. You don't think that the jewels would be big enough and be buried in her body.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta got the Pyramid accessories for Areda. Ugh. Gross.

0.0: Such a shame... Any jewelry, any sparkling gem will lose its luster should it appear near me. \r\n#L0##b...#l\n#k
